name: zpulse
description: Zcash network observatory: shielded supply integrity, turnstile migration, and per-block privacy mix, live from a Zcash node.

scripts.node:start: docker run -d --name zpulse-zebrad -p 8232:8232 -p 8233:8233 -e ZEBRA_RPC__LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:8232 -e ZEBRA_RPC__ENABLE_COOKIE_AUTH=false -v zebrad-data:/home/zebra/.cache/zebra docker.io/zfnd/zebra:latest
scripts.node:stop: docker stop zpulse-zebrad && docker rm zpulse-zebrad
